assumptions: harness:brainstorming was invoked and run autonomously with recommended defaults. Its own When-to-Use excludes simple refactors with no design decisions, and the scope was already settled by a human, so there was no spec and no sign-off step. The only choices (names, rename versus reuse) were made by recommendation.

harness:autopilot was NOT invoked. Its When-to-Use needs an approved multi-phase spec and excludes single-phase work, and this change has neither. harness:refactoring was followed as discipline (green before, identical behavior, green after) but not invoked, so it is not listed in stages.

The 7 remaining py* lines are domain names about Python source files, not Python-emulation helpers: pyFiles (core/domain-scanner.ts), pyModulePath (core/test-inventory.ts), pyTautology (core/vacuity-scanner.ts). They are left alone.

No shared helper was reused. util/round.ts formatWithDecimalPoint uses `${x}.0` while pyFloatStr used toFixed(1); they differ for integers of 1e21 and above. diff-coverage parseStrictInt takes a string while pyIntFromValue takes unknown and stringifies numbers. Both private copies were renamed instead.

The per-module private copies differ from each other (for example quoteValue in mcp-validator.ts only wraps in single quotes, while pr-check.ts also renders arrays and objects). They were renamed in place, not merged, to keep the change behavior-free.
Header rewrites remove only the port claim and any sentence that depended on it. 'Python->TS nuances' blocks that describe behavior the code still reproduces were kept, as the settled scope says.

Renaming pyGet to the longer getOrDefault made prettier wrap parseStatuses in core/workflow-discovery.ts past the 50-line function-length threshold (a new arch violation). A module-level `type JsonRow = Record<string, unknown>` alias used inside parseStatuses brings it back to 46 lines, with no runtime effect.

The packaged npm install ships dist/, so the registry sits at dist/data/frameworks/registry.json (ts/src/data/frameworks/registry.json in source, copied by scripts/copy-data.mjs). The new description names the path relative to the package data dir: data/frameworks/registry.json.
